'''Wind-ships''' were a type of marine vessel developed by the people of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. After crash-landing on the planet, the Weik settlers underwent a technological regression and the collapse of civilization and industry. Over the millennia, the people recovered and began to reinvent technologies long thought of as archaic across the civilized galaxy. Wind-ships were a product of the ingenuity of the people of Weik, using their understanding of the wind currents to create [[Boat/Legends|boats]] which floated atop the waves, powered by sails that caught the wind. [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] captains led cargo ships across the planet and allowed for global trade and commerce to develop.
